JN Deb, Advocate instructed by Sharifuddin Chaklader, Advocate-on-Record -For the Petitioners.

parties:
Sharifuddin Ahmed (Md) and ors ------ Petitioners
Vs.
Md Ala Uddin and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 3. The suit was filed in a representative character for declaration of jote right and title by adverse possession in the suit land measuring 12.99 acres of land stating, inter alia, that villagers have been holding the land in jote right for over 100 years under Chowdhury Mirasdars and making use thereof by catching fish and growing Boro paddy and also acquired title by adverse possession. Hazi Rifat Ullah and Hazi Arjad Ali and others, on behalf of the villagers and with their money, purchased some share in the permanently settled tanks attracting the suit land; that the suit land was originally a beel and the plaintiffs was holding the same on payment of rent at first to the mirasdars and then to the Government; that the beel was silted up long before 1360 BS and the plaintiffs were growing Boro crops, but the same was recorded in SA survey as Beel in Khatian of the Government which they learnt on 20-5-1978 for the first time.
